svg.title: Nigeria: advertising cost per person who started the survey, in ten whole-state targets, 2023–2026
svg.desc: Kano $0.08 (1,422 started); FCT $0.20 (1,407 started); Rivers $0.25 (771 started); Nasarawa $1.11 (575 started); Niger $1.19 (620 started); Adamawa $1.65 (188 started); Lagos $1.88 (4,546 started); Sokoto $2.41 (502 started); Anambra $2.84 (368 started); Bauchi $6.36 (5,462 started).
svg.text: NIGERIA · WHOLE STATES, ADVERTISING COST PER PERSON WHO STARTED
Each coloured state was targeted whole (a Meta region). Every recruitment that targeted it is pooled:
spend summed, people summed. Groups of states and the whole country are in the table below.
